Trace, implement and test: join3

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
SELECT DISTINCT P.PATIENT_ID, P.P_FIRST_NAME, P.P_AGE, P.ADDRESS, P.CONTACT_NUMBER
FROM PATIENT P, APPOINTMENT A
WHERE P.PATIENT_ID = A.PATIENT_ID
    AND MONTH(A.APP_DATE) = 6
    AND YEAR(A.APP_DATE) = 2019
ORDER BY P.PATIENT_ID;
